correctness.rationale: A map with only one nonzero displacement is a bijection exactly when the moved support is a union of pairs {u,u+d}; setting H={0,d} makes chi translation invariant. Substituting f(u)=u+d chi(u) proves the characteristic-two local Yang–Baxter identity. In the sequential carrier sweep each local operation adds d eta_i simultaneously to site and carrier, with eta_i=chi(x_i+b) unchanged by every d-translation. Thus T²=id and T fixes exactly q(q-s)^L full states; all else form 2-cycles. Distinct nonempty supports identify their unique d and total count 1+(q-1)(2^(q/2)-1). Independently checked XOR enumeration of all q=4,8 masks for L=1..3 and exact fixed counts; this is finite corroboration only.
